Which statements about diffusion are correct?
1
Aqueous ions cannot diffuse in water.
2
Diffusion is caused by the random movement of particles.
3
Particles spread out in all directions in diffusion.
4
Diffusion can only take place in solids and liquids.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
